sentence_stem: Of all the cities we visited,
full_sentence: Of all the cities we visited, Lviv was the most beautiful.
acceptable_variants: Lviv was the most beautiful of them.
Lviv was the most beautiful city of all.

explanation: After 'of all', we need a superlative form with 'the most' that ranks one item above the rest of the group. The completion has to name the top item in that group.
